_instructions: Paper Trail backlog. Issue numbers on GitHub match the order below (#1 to #13). Every issue has one type label, one priority label and a milestone.

issues.title: Scaffold the Next.js app and deploy it to Vercel
issues.user_story: As a developer, I want the empty app running on Vercel from day one so deploying is never the risky last step.
acceptance_criteria: Next.js 15 App Router + TypeScript (strict) + Tailwind runs locally with npm run dev
Tailwind theme is generated from the DESIGN.md tokens
Folder layout matches AGENTS.md section 1.3
main deploys to production on Vercel and every PR gets a preview URL
.env.example lists DATABASE_URL, NEXTAUTH_SECRET, NEXTAUTH_URL and BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN with no values
GET /api/health returns 200 and checks the database connection

issues.title: Add CI with lint, typecheck, tests, build and a security scan
issues.user_story: As a developer, I want every PR checked automatically so broken code can't reach main.
acceptance_criteria: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs on every pull request
Jobs run in order: lint and typecheck, Vitest, next build, Playwright
npm audit runs as its own job and fails on high severity
Tests run against a Postgres service container, never the prod database
Branch protection on main requires green CI and one approval
Husky pre-commit runs lint-staged

issues.title: Add sign up and sign in with Tenant, Manager and Organizer roles
issues.user_story: As any user, I want to sign in and land on the screen for my role so I only see what I'm allowed to see. (PRD US1)
acceptance_criteria: Sign up with email, password, role and building; passwords hashed with bcrypt
NextAuth credentials provider with JWT sessions; role and buildingId are in the token
Tenants land on /incidents, managers on /queue, organizers on /building
Signed-out users are redirected to /login
requireRole() helper returns 401 when signed out and 403 for the wrong role
Tests cover each role, signed out, wrong role and a bad password

issues.title: Create the Prisma schema for users, buildings, incidents and events
issues.user_story: As a developer, I want the data model in a migration so both of us and CI share the same database shape.
acceptance_criteria: Models User, Building, Incident, IncidentEvent and Photo as described in AGENTS.md section 1.3
Enums for role, category, reportedVia, status and event type
Migration committed under prisma/migrations
npm run db:seed creates 2 buildings, 1 manager, 1 organizer, 4 tenants and 6 incidents with events
lib/days-ignored.ts has unit tests for open, acknowledged and resolved incidents with frozen time

issues.title: Log an incident with photos
issues.user_story: As a tenant, I want to log a problem with photos and when I reported it so I have a dated record. (PRD US2)
acceptance_criteria: Form at /incidents/new with category, title (required, max 120), description (max 2000), reported-at (required, not in the future) and reported-via
Up to 5 photos, JPEG/PNG/HEIC, 10 MB each, with previews and remove buttons
Invalid input shows an error under the field and nothing is saved
POST /api/incidents rejects the same invalid input with 400, even if the client check is skipped
On success the tenant lands on /incidents/[id] with a Reported event and 0 days ignored
Only tenants can create incidents (403 for other roles, 401 signed out)

issues.title: Show the tenant incident list and timeline
issues.user_story: As a tenant, I want to see each incident as a timeline so I can show exactly what happened and when. (PRD US3)
acceptance_criteria: /incidents lists my incidents newest first with status and days-ignored badges
/incidents/[id] shows events oldest first with mono timestamps, matching the wireframe
Days ignored counts whole days from reported-at to acknowledgement, or to now if not acknowledged
Opening another tenant's incident returns 404
Empty state with a Log an incident button; loading and error states present

issues.title: Build the manager queue with acknowledge, respond and resolve
issues.user_story: As a property manager, I want one queue of open issues so I can work through them oldest first. (PRD US4)
acceptance_criteria: /queue lists open and acknowledged incidents for my buildings, sorted by days ignored, highest first
Acknowledge, Respond and Resolve each add a timestamped IncidentEvent
Respond and Resolve require a note; empty notes are rejected with 400
Acting on an incident in a building I don't manage returns 403
Layout matches the queue in docs/design/wireframe.html

issues.title: Push live status updates with server-sent events
issues.user_story: As a tenant, I want status changes to show up without refreshing so I know right away when someone responds. (PRD US5)
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/events streams new IncidentEvents the signed-in user is allowed to see
Tenant timeline, manager queue and organizer dashboard update within 5 seconds
Falls back to polling every 10 seconds if the stream drops
Two-browser Playwright test: manager acknowledges, tenant sees it without reloading

issues.title: Build the organizer building dashboard
issues.user_story: As an organizer, I want to see every incident in my building so I can tell whether a problem is building-wide. (PRD US6)
acceptance_criteria: /building shows counts by category and status and median days to acknowledge
Incident list hides tenant names and shows units
Filters by category, status and date range
Flags a category as a pattern when 3 or more units report it within 30 days
Only organizers of that building can see it (403 otherwise)

issues.title: Export a building timeline PDF
issues.user_story: As an organizer, I want to export one PDF of every incident so I can attach it to a complaint. (PRD US7)
acceptance_criteria: Export PDF on /building downloads a file with a summary page and every incident in time order with its events
Respects the dashboard filters
Shows units, not tenant names, unless the tenant opted in
Photo thumbnails with timestamps
Integration test checks the PDF has one section per incident

issues.title: Add the public building report card API and OpenAPI docs
issues.user_story: As a prospective renter, I want a public score for a building so I can see how it treats tenants before I sign a lease. (PRD US8)
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/buildings/:id/score returns buildingId, medianResponseHours, openCount and topCategories
No names, units, photos or incident text in the response
Rate limited to 60 requests per minute per IP (429 after that)
404 for unknown buildings
docs/api/openapi.yaml documents the endpoint, response and errors

issues.title: Add E2E tests and accessibility checks for every user flow
issues.user_story: As a team, we want every flow in AGENTS.md section 2.3 covered end to end so regressions get caught before merge.
acceptance_criteria: One Playwright spec per flow: sign in, log incident, handle incident, tenant sees response, organizer export
Each spec runs axe with zero serious or critical violations
E2E job runs in CI against a seeded test database
Line coverage on lib/ is at least 80%

issues.title: Write the README, architecture and database diagrams
issues.user_story: As a grader or new teammate, I want setup steps and diagrams so I can run and understand the app quickly.
acceptance_criteria: README has the live URL, local setup, test commands and deploy steps
docs/architecture.md has an architecture diagram and an ER diagram of the Prisma schema
Contribution log lists the PRs and reviews
Demo video link added before Nov 13
